description:
I’m Rushikesh, an Engineering Admission Counsellor focused on helping students make smart and realistic admission choices.

I guide students through college and branch selection by analysing their MHT-CET/JEE scores, cutoff trends, and available options, while keeping future scope and practicality in mind. My counselling style is clear, honest, and step-by-step, so students feel confident during CAP rounds and option filling.

I collaborate with Aditya (COEP) to provide trusted, data-driven guidance, ensuring students receive accurate information and real insights about engineering admissions in Maharashtra.
